_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_

**Do not inline admin or virtual keys into rendered manifests.**

`masterKey` is written directly into Helm values, and `createKeyProvisioningJob()` bakes `masterKey` plus every virtual key into the Job command. That leaks secrets in synthesized YAML / `kubectl get` output, and the shell interpolation is injection-prone if any value contains `'`, backticks, or `$()`. Use Kubernetes `Secret`s plus `secretKeyRef`/mounted files and build the request body at runtime without string interpolation.  



Also applies to: 124-172

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

In `@packages/charts/litellm/src/construct.ts` around lines 58 - 63, The Helm
values currently inline secrets (computed.masterkey and virtual keys) and
createKeyProvisioningJob bakes them into a shell command; instead create a
Kubernetes Secret resource containing masterKey and any virtual/admin keys (one
secret with distinct keys), remove masterKey from the LitellmValues object, and
update computed to reference the secret via secretKeyRef or a volume mount (not
plain text); modify createKeyProvisioningJob to read secret values at runtime
from environment variables populated by secretKeyRef or from mounted files and
construct the request body programmatically (avoid shell string interpolation
and echoing secrets), ensuring no secrets appear in rendered manifests or
commands.
```

</details>
